name: gener liste prix
script:
# -------------------------------------------------- # 0) RÉCUP PARAMÈTRES HTTP # -------------------------------------------------- # Depuis l'appel JS: # frappe.call({ # method: 'gener_list_prix', # args: { # list_group_item: groups, // tableau JS # list_prix: frm.doc.liste_des_prix // ex "Compte Pro" # }, # }) list_group_item = frappe.form_dict.get("list_group_item", "[]") price_list = frappe.form_dict.get("list_prix", "Compte Pro") if isinstance(list_group_item, str): try: list_group_item = json.loads(list_group_item) except Exception: # fallback : une seule valeur list_group_item = [list_group_item] # -------------------------------------------------- # 1) JSON D’ORDRE DU CATALOGUE # -------------------------------------------------- order = { "Adoucisseurs": [ "Adoucisseurs Domestiques", "Adoucisseurs Commerciaux", "Bacs à sels", "Consommables & Accessoires", "Vannes de commande" ], "Vannes de commande": [ "Vannes adoucisseurs manuelles", "Vannes adoucisseurs automatiques" ], "Équipements & Instruments": [ "Armoires & composants électriques", "Contrôleurs", "Instruments de mesure", "Tests d’analyse" ], "Armoires & composants électriques": [ "Armoires de commande", "Accessoires électriques" ], "Équipements de Filtration & Vannes": [ "Porte-filtres", "Bouteilles FRP", "Stérilisateurs UV", "Cartouches filtrantes", "Médias filtrants", "Électrovannes", "Vannes multi-voies" ], "Stérilisateurs UV": [ "Filtres UV", "Accessoires UV" ], "Vannes multi-voies": [ "Vannes à pointeau", "Vannes manuelles", "Vannes automatiques" ], "Cartouches filtrantes": [ "Cartouches anti-sédiment", "Cartouches lavables", "Cartouches anti-calcaire", "Filtres T33", "Cartouches à charbon", "Cartouches plissées (anti-bactériennes inf 1 micron)" ], "Osmoseurs Inverses RO": [ "Osmoseurs Domestiques", "Osmoseurs Commerciaux", "Osmoseurs Industriels", "Bi-osmose", "Fontaines", "Accessoires Osmoseurs" ], "Osmoseurs Domestiques": [ "RO domestique sans pompe", "RO domestique avec pompe", "RO flux direct", "RO Consommables & Kits d’entretien" ], "Accessoires Osmoseurs": [ "Coudes", "Connecteurs droits", "Connecteurs T", "Connecteurs Y", "Clips & colliers", "Clés de serrage", "Électrovannes & automatismes", "Raccords spéciaux", "Vannes & régulation", "Accessoires divers" ], "Pompes & Accessoires": [ "Adaptateurs pour booster osmoseurs", "Pompes booster pour osmoseurs", "Pompes de surface & puits", "Pompes multicellulaires", "Pompes volumétriques", "Pompes doseuses", "Accessoires de pompes" ], "Pompes de surface & puits": [ "Pompes périphériques", "Pompes auto-amorçantes", "Pompes inox" ], "Membranes RO": [ "Membranes RO domestiques (≤100 GPD)", "Membranes RO commerciales (≤800 GPD)", "Membranes RO industrielles (4040/8040)", "Porte-membranes RO" ], "Produits Chimiques": [ "Antiscalants", "Acides & Bases", "Produits Désinfectants" ], "Réservoirs, Tuyauterie & Robinetterie": [ "Citernes & Réservoirs", "Robinetterie", "Tuyauterie" ], "Citernes & Réservoirs": [ "Réservoirs pressurisés horizontaux", "Réservoirs pressurisés verticaux", "Citernes alimentaires" ], "Robinetterie": [ "Robinets", "Mitigeurs" ] } # -------------------------------------------------- # 2) UTILITAIRES GROUPES # -------------------------------------------------- def get_child_groups(parent): return frappe.get_all( "Item Group", filters={"parent_item_group": parent}, pluck="name" ) def is_leaf_group(group_name): return len(get_child_groups(group_name)) == 0 def get_ordered_group_tree(main_group): """ Retourne [main_group] + tous les descendants dans l’ordre défini par `order` puis alphabétique pour le reste. """ result = [main_group] children = get_child_groups(main_group) if not children: return result if main_group not in order: # Aucun ordre custom → tri alpha + récursif for child in sorted(children): result += get_ordered_group_tree(child) return result # 1) Enfants dans l’ordre du JSON for child in order[main_group]: if child in children: result += get_ordered_group_tree(child) # 2) Enfants non mentionnés → alpha remaining = sorted(set(children) - set(order[main_group])) for child in remaining: result += get_ordered_group_tree(child) return result def get_parent_groups(group_name): """ Retourne la chaîne des groupes parents pour un groupe donné : [parent, grand_parent, ...] """ parents = [] current = group_name while True: parent = frappe.db.get_value("Item Group", current, "parent_item_group") if not parent or parent == current: break parents.append(parent) current = parent return parents # -------------------------------------------------- # 3) AIDE POUR VARIANTS # -------------------------------------------------- def get_template_attribute_order(template): """ Retourne la liste des attributs (dans l'ordre ERPNext, idx asc) pour un template donné. """ rows = frappe.get_all( "Item Variant Attribute", filters={"parent": template}, fields=["attribute"], order_by="idx asc", ) return [r["attribute"] for r in rows] def get_attribute_value_priority(attribute): """ Pour un attribut donné, retourne un dict: { 'valeur': index_ordre } en respectant l'ordre ERPNext (idx asc) dans Item Attribute Value. """ rows = frappe.get_all( "Item Attribute Value", filters={"parent": attribute}, fields=["attribute_value"], order_by="idx asc", ) mapping = {} idx = 0 for r in rows: val = r.get("attribute_value") if val and val not in mapping: mapping[val] = idx idx += 1 return mapping def get_variant_attributes(item_code): """Retourne { attribut: valeur } pour une variante donnée.""" rows = frappe.get_all( "Item Variant Attribute", filters={"parent": item_code}, fields=["attribute", "attribute_value"], ) result = {} for r in rows: attr = r.get("attribute") val = r.get("attribute_value") if attr: result[attr] = val return result def build_variant_sort_key(item, attrs_order, attr_value_priority): """ Clé de tri pour UNE variante d'un template. - On parcourt les attributs du template de la FIN vers le DÉBUT - Chaque valeur est ordonnée selon Item Attribute Value """ v_attrs = item.get("variant_attributes") or {} key_parts = [] for attr in attrs_order[::-1]: val = v_attrs.get(attr) prio_map = attr_value_priority.get(attr) or {} prio = prio_map.get(val, 9999) # valeur inconnue → bas de la liste key_parts.append(prio) price = item.get("price") if price is None: price = 10 ** 9 code = item.get("item_code") or "" key_parts.append(price) key_parts.append(code) return tuple(key_parts) # -------------------------------------------------- # 4) ITEMS PAR GROUPES # -------------------------------------------------- def get_items_from_groups(group_list, price_list): if not group_list: return [] placeholders = ",".join(["%s"] * len(group_list)) sql = f""" SELECT i.item_code, i.item_name, i.item_group, i.variant_of, i.stock_uom, i.brand, i.description, ip.price_list_rate AS price, ips.price_list_rate AS base_price, CASE WHEN it.item_tax_template LIKE '%%19%%' THEN 19 WHEN it.item_tax_template LIKE '%%7%%' THEN 7 ELSE 0 END AS tax_rate, CASE WHEN it.item_tax_template LIKE '%%19%%' THEN ROUND(ip.price_list_rate / 1.19,3) WHEN it.item_tax_template LIKE '%%7%%' THEN ROUND(ip.price_list_rate / 1.07,3) ELSE ROUND(ip.price_list_rate,3) END AS price_ht, CASE WHEN ips.price_list_rate IS NULL OR ips.price_list_rate = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ip.price_list_rate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((ips.price_list_rate - ip.price_list_rate) / ips.price_list_rate) * 100, 2) END AS remise FROM `tabItem` i LEFT JOIN `tabItem Price` ip ON ip.item_code = i.item_code AND ip.price_list = %s LEFT JOIN `tabItem Price` ips ON ips.item_code = i.item_code AND ips.price_list = 'Vente standard' LEFT JOIN `tabItem Tax` it ON it.parent = i.item_code WHERE i.item_group IN ({placeholders}) AND i.disabled = 0 AND i.is_sales_item = 1 AND i.has_variants = 0 """ params = [price_list] + list(group_list) items = frappe.db.sql(sql, params, as_dict=True) # Nettoyer descriptions HTML + collecter templates templates = set() for it in items: html = it.get("description") or "" html = ( html.replace("
", "\n") .replace("
", "\n") .replace("
", "\n") ) it["description"] = frappe.utils.strip_html(html).strip() if it.get("variant_of"): templates.add(it["variant_of"]) # Préparer infos de tri variantes template_attr_order = {} attr_value_priority = {} for template in templates: attrs = get_template_attribute_order(template) template_attr_order[template] = attrs for attr in attrs: if attr not in attr_value_priority: attr_value_priority[attr] = get_attribute_value_priority(attr) # Attributs pour chaque variante for it in items: if it.get("variant_of"): it["variant_attributes"] = get_variant_attributes(it["item_code"]) # Respecter l’ordre des groupes et tri internes ordered_items = [] for grp in group_list: group_items = [it for it in items if it["item_group"] == grp] if not group_items: continue simple_items = [] variants_by_template = {} for it in group_items: template = it.get("variant_of") if template: variants_by_template.setdefault(template, []).append(it) else: simple_items.append(it) # Prix des templates (price_list ou min des variantes) template_prices = {} if variants_by_template: template_codes = list(variants_by_template.keys()) rows = frappe.get_all( "Item Price", filters={ "item_code": ["in", template_codes], "price_list": price_list, }, fields=["item_code", "price_list_rate"], ) for r in rows: template_prices[r["item_code"]] = r["price_list_rate"] for template in variants_by_template: if template not in template_prices or template_prices[template] is None: min_price = None for it in variants_by_template[template]: p = it.get("price") if p is not None: min_price = p if min_price is None else min(min_price, p) if min_price is None: min_price = 10 ** 9 template_prices[template] = min_price # Construire blocs (simples + templates) blocks = [] for it in simple_items: p = it.get("price") if it.get("price") is not None else 10 ** 9 blocks.append({ "type": "simple", "price": p, "item": it, }) for template in variants_by_template: p = template_prices.get(template, 10 ** 9) blocks.append({ "type": "template", "price": p, "template": template, "variants": variants_by_template[template], }) # Tri des blocs def block_sort_key(block): if block["type"] == "simple": code = block["item"].get("item_code") or "" return (block["price"], 0, code) else: code = block["template"] or "" return (block["price"], 1, code) blocks = sorted(blocks, key=block_sort_key) # Dérouler les blocs for block in blocks: if block["type"] == "simple": ordered_items.append(block["item"]) else: template = block["template"] variants = block["variants"] attrs_order = template_attr_order.get(template) or [] if attrs_order: variants = sorted( variants, key=lambda x: build_variant_sort_key( x, attrs_order, attr_value_priority ), ) else: variants = sorted( variants, key=lambda x: ( x.get("price") if x.get("price") is not None else 10 ** 9, x.get("item_code") or "", ), ) ordered_items.extend(variants) return ordered_items # -------------------------------------------------- # 5) PRICING RULES # -------------------------------------------------- def describe_pricing_rule(rule, mixed_conditions=False): """ Construit une description lisible d'une Pricing Rule. mixed_conditions = True → la condition de quantité s'applique au cumul de tous les articles sélectionnés (groupe / item list). """ parts = [] pct = rule.get("discount_percentage") amt = rule.get("discount_amount") rate = rule.get("rate") cur = rule.get("currency") or "" # --- type de remise / prix --- if pct: parts.append(f"Remise de {pct:.2f} %") elif amt: parts.append(f"Remise de {amt:.2f} {cur}") elif rate: parts.append(f"Prix fixé à {rate:.3f} {cur}") # --- conditions de quantité --- min_qty = rule.get("min_qty") max_qty = rule.get("max_qty") if min_qty and max_qty: parts.append(f"pour une quantité entre {float(min_qty)} et {float(max_qty)}") elif min_qty: parts.append(f"à partir de {float(min_qty)} unités") elif max_qty: parts.append(f"jusqu'à {float(max_qty)} unités") # --- conditions de montant --- min_amt = rule.get("min_amt") max_amt = rule.get("max_amt") if min_amt and max_amt: parts.append(f"pour un montant entre {float(min_amt)} et {float(max_amt)}") elif min_amt: parts.append(f"à partir d'un montant de {float(min_amt)}") elif max_amt: parts.append(f"jusqu'à un montant de {float(max_amt)}") # --- période de validité --- valid_from = rule.get("valid_from") valid_upto = rule.get("valid_upto") if valid_from and valid_upto: parts.append(f"valable du {valid_from} au {valid_upto}") elif valid_from: parts.append(f"valable à partir du {valid_from}") elif valid_upto: parts.append(f"valable jusqu'au {valid_upto}") # --- Mixed Conditions (quantité cumulée) --- if mixed_conditions: parts.append( "\n⚠️ La quantité prise en compte est le cumul de tous les articles concernés " "(ex. 5 pièces du modèle A + 5 pièces du modèle B = 10 pièces pour le seuil de remise)." ) return ", ".join(parts) def compute_rule_sort_value(r): """Valeur numérique qui sert à trier les règles par 'intensité' de réduction.""" perc = r.get("discount_percentage") if perc not in (None, 0): try: return float(perc) except Exception: pass amt = r.get("discount_amount") if amt not in (None, 0): try: return float(amt) except Exception: pass rate = r.get("rate") if rate not in (None, 0): try: return float(rate) except Exception: pass return 0.0 def extract_percent_from_desc(desc): """ Essaie d'extraire le pourcentage de remise depuis une description du type : 'Remise de 10.00 %, ...' Retourne un float (0.0 si non trouvé). """ if not desc: return 0.0 txt = str(desc) # On cherche la sous-chaîne "Remise de" marker = "Remise de" pos = txt.find(marker) if pos == -1: return 0.0 # Position juste après "Remise de" start = pos + len(marker) # Sous-chaîne à partir de là sub = txt[start:] # On coupe au pourcentage "%" percent_pos = sub.find("%") if percent_pos == -1: return 0.0 num_part = sub[:percent_pos].strip() # ex: "10.00" ou "10,00" ou "10.00 ," if not num_part: return 0.0 # On prend uniquement le premier "mot" numérique # (séparé par espace) num_token = num_part.split()[0] # Remplacer virgule par point si besoin num_token = num_token.replace(",", ".") try: return float(num_token) except Exception: return 0.0 def build_multi_item_sets(multi_item_rules): """ Regroupe les 'multi_item_rules' par ensemble d'articles et construit une description globale TRIÉE de la plus petite remise à la plus grande. Entrée : ------- multi_item_rules = [ { "pricing_rule": "PRLE-0201", "items": [...], "description": "Remise de 20.00 %, ..." }, { "pricing_rule": "PRLE-0200", "items": [...], "description": "Remise de 10.00 %, ..." }, ... ] Sortie : ------- [ { "item_group": "", "items": [... liste des codes ...], "description": "Remise de 10 % ...\nRemise de 20 % ..." }, ... ] """ if not multi_item_rules: return [] grouped = {} # 1) Regrouper par ensemble d'articles (clé = tuple trié) for r in multi_item_rules: items = r.get("items") or [] if not items: continue key = tuple(sorted(items)) # [A,B,C] == [C,B,A] grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(r) multi_item_sets = [] # 2) Construire la description globale triée par remise croissante for items_tuple, rules in grouped.items(): items_list = list(items_tuple) # Groupe représentatif = item_group du premier article item_group = None try: first_item = items_list[0] item_group = frappe.db.get_value("Item", first_item, "item_group") except Exception: item_group = None # Trier les règles par pourcentage de remise croissant, # en lisant ce pourcentage dans 'description' rules_sorted = sorted( rules, key=lambda r: extract_percent_from_desc(r.get("description") or "") ) desc_lines = [] for r in rules_sorted: d = (r.get("description") or "").strip() if d: desc_lines.append(d) full_desc = "\n".join(desc_lines) multi_item_sets.append({ "item_group": item_group, "items": items_list, "description": full_desc, }) return multi_item_sets def get_pricing_rules_for_items(total_items, price_list): """ Retourne les règles de prix liées aux groupes et aux items présents dans total_items. Sortie : -------- { "group_rules": [...], "item_rules": [...], "group_descriptions": [...], "item_descriptions": [...], "multi_item_rules": [...] # promos multi-articles (mixed_conditions) } """ item_codes_set = set() item_groups_set = set() for it in total_items: code = it.get("item_code") grp = it.get("item_group") if code: item_codes_set.add(code) if grp: # groupe direct de l'article item_groups_set.add(grp) # ✅ ajouter tous les groupes parents (Osmoseurs Domestiques, etc.) for parent in get_parent_groups(grp): item_groups_set.add(parent) item_codes = list(item_codes_set) item_groups = list(item_groups_set) group_rules = [] item_rules = [] multi_item_rules = [] # ✅ règles multi-articles (Apply On = Item Code + mixed_conditions) # ============================================================ # 1) RÈGLES SUR GROUPES D'ARTICLES (Apply On = Item Group) # ============================================================ if item_groups: group_rows = frappe.get_all( "Pricing Rule Item Group", filters={"item_group": ["in", item_groups]}, fields=["parent", "item_group"], # parent = name de Pricing Rule ) if group_rows: groups_by_rule = {} for row in group_rows: rule_name = row.get("parent") grp = row.get("item_group") if rule_name and grp: groups_by_rule.setdefault(rule_name, set()).add(grp) rule_names = list(groups_by_rule.keys()) rules = frappe.get_all( "Pricing Rule", filters={ "name": ["in", rule_names], "selling": 1, "for_price_list": price_list, }, fields=[ "name", "discount_percentage", "discount_amount", "rate", "currency", "min_qty", "max_qty", "min_amt", "max_amt", "valid_from", "valid_upto", "mixed_conditions", ], ) for r in rules: rule_name = r.get("name") has_mixed = bool(r.get("mixed_conditions")) desc = describe_pricing_rule(r, has_mixed) sort_value = compute_rule_sort_value(r) for grp in groups_by_rule.get(rule_name, []): group_rules.append({ "item_group": grp, "pricing_rule": rule_name, "discount_percentage": r.get("discount_percentage"), "discount_amount": r.get("discount_amount"), "rate": r.get("rate"), "currency": r.get("currency"), "mixed_conditions": has_mixed, "sort_value": sort_value, "description": desc, }) # ============================================================ # 2) RÈGLES SUR ITEMS (Apply On = Item Code) # ============================================================ if item_codes: item_rows = frappe.get_all( "Pricing Rule Item Code", filters={"item_code": ["in", item_codes]}, fields=["parent", "item_code"], # parent = name de Pricing Rule ) if item_rows: items_by_rule = {} for row in item_rows: rule_name = row.get("parent") code = row.get("item_code") if rule_name and code: items_by_rule.setdefault(rule_name, set()).add(code) rule_names = list(items_by_rule.keys()) rules = frappe.get_all( "Pricing Rule", filters={ "name": ["in", rule_names], "selling": 1, "for_price_list": price_list, }, fields=[ "name", "discount_percentage", "discount_amount", "rate", "currency", "min_qty", "max_qty", "min_amt", "max_amt", "valid_from", "valid_upto", "mixed_conditions", ], ) for r in rules: rule_name = r.get("name") has_mixed = bool(r.get("mixed_conditions")) desc = describe_pricing_rule(r, has_mixed) sort_value = compute_rule_sort_value(r) related_items = items_by_rule.get(rule_name, set()) # ✅ Si la règle est mixed_conditions et touche plusieurs articles, # on la stocke aussi dans multi_item_rules (pour l'afficher en haut du groupe principal) if has_mixed and len(related_items) > 1: multi_item_rules.append({ "pricing_rule": rule_name, "items": sorted(list(related_items)), "description": desc, }) for code in related_items: item_rules.append({ "item_code": code, "pricing_rule": rule_name, "discount_percentage": r.get("discount_percentage"), "discount_amount": r.get("discount_amount"), "rate": r.get("rate"), "currency": r.get("currency"), "mixed_conditions": has_mixed, "sort_value": sort_value, "description": desc, }) # ============================================================ # 3) AGRÉGATION DESCRIPTIONS PAR GROUPE / ITEM # ============================================================ group_desc_map = {} for r in group_rules: grp = r.get("item_group") if not grp: continue group_desc_map.setdefault(grp, []).append({ "sort_value": r.get("sort_value") or 0, "description": r.get("description") or "", }) item_desc_map = {} for r in item_rules: code = r.get("item_code") if not code: continue item_desc_map.setdefault(code, []).append({ "sort_value": r.get("sort_value") or 0, "description": r.get("description") or "", }) group_descriptions = [] for grp, lst in group_desc_map.items(): lst_sorted = sorted(lst, key=lambda x: x["sort_value"]) full_desc = "\n".join(e["description"] for e in lst_sorted if e["description"]) group_descriptions.append({ "item_group": grp, "description": full_desc, }) item_descriptions = [] for code, lst in item_desc_map.items(): lst_sorted = sorted(lst, key=lambda x: x["sort_value"]) full_desc = " ; ".join(e["description"] for e in lst_sorted if e["description"]) item_descriptions.append({ "item_code": code, "description": full_desc, }) multi_item_sets = build_multi_item_sets(multi_item_rules) return { "group_rules": group_rules, "item_rules": item_rules, "group_descriptions": group_descriptions, "item_descriptions": item_descriptions, "multi_item_rules": multi_item_rules, # détail par règle "multi_item_sets": multi_item_sets, # ✅ résumé global } # -------------------------------------------------- # 6) CALCUL DU PRIX TTC PROMO MINIMUM PAR ARTICLE # -------------------------------------------------- def apply_rule_to_price(base_price, rule): """ Applique une Pricing Rule à un prix TTC de base et retourne le prix TTC résultant. """ try: base = float(base_price) except Exception: return base_price pct = rule.get("discount_percentage") or 0 amt = rule.get("discount_amount") or 0 rate = rule.get("rate") # On applique une seule logique par règle (priorité comme dans describe_pricing_rule) if pct: try: return base * (1 - float(pct) / 100.0) except Exception: return base elif amt: try: return max(base - float(amt), 0) except Exception: return base elif rate: try: return float(rate) except Exception: return base return base def inject_min_promo_price_on_items(total_items, pricing_rules_info): """ Ajoute sur chaque item un champ 'prix_ttc_promo' : - prix TTC minimum atteignable avec les promotions - None si aucune promo ne baisse le prix ⚠️ Très important : Chaque règle est testée INDÉPENDAMMENT sur le prix catalogue `price`. On ne cumule pas plusieurs remises les unes sur les autres. """ item_rules = pricing_rules_info.get("item_rules", []) or [] group_rules = pricing_rules_info.get("group_rules", []) or [] # Indexer les règles par article et par groupe rules_by_item = {} for r in item_rules: code = r.get("item_code") if not code: continue rules_by_item.setdefault(code, []).append(r) rules_by_group = {} for r in group_rules: grp = r.get("item_group") if not grp: continue rules_by_group.setdefault(grp, []).append(r) # Calcul pour chaque item for it in total_items: base_price = it.get("price") if base_price in (None, 0): it["prix_ttc_promo"] = None continue try: base = float(base_price) except Exception: it["prix_ttc_promo"] = None continue item_code = it.get("item_code") grp = it.get("item_group") # Règles directes sur l'article applicable_rules = list(rules_by_item.get(item_code, [])) # Règles sur le groupe + tous les parents all_groups = [] if grp: all_groups.append(grp) all_groups.extend(get_parent_groups(grp)) for g in all_groups: applicable_rules.extend(rules_by_group.get(g, [])) if not applicable_rules: it["prix_ttc_promo"] = None continue best_price = base has_better = False # 🔑 Chaque règle est testée à partir de `base`, pas du prix déjà remisé for rule in applicable_rules: trial = apply_rule_to_price(base, rule) try: trial = float(trial) except Exception: continue if trial < best_price: best_price = trial has_better = True # Si aucune règle ne baisse le prix catalogue : pas de prix promo affiché if has_better: it["prix_ttc_promo"] = round(best_price, 3) else: it["prix_ttc_promo"] = None # -------------------------------------------------- # 7) PIPELINE FINAL # -------------------------------------------------- total_items = [] for top_group in list_group_item: children = get_child_groups(top_group) if len(children) == 0: # pas de sous-groupes → articles directement items = get_items_from_groups([top_group], price_list) total_items.extend(items) continue # groupe avec sous-groupes → on ne prend que les feuilles (dans l'ordre défini) ordered_groups = get_ordered_group_tree(top_group) leaf_groups = [g for g in ordered_groups if is_leaf_group(g)] items = get_items_from_groups(leaf_groups, price_list) total_items.extend(items) # Règles de tarification liées aux items/groupe générés pricing_rules_info = get_pricing_rules_for_items(total_items, price_list) # Calcul du prix TTC minimum promo pour chaque article inject_min_promo_price_on_items(total_items, pricing_rules_info) # En console : print("ITEMS:") print(total_items) print("PRICING RULES:") print(pricing_rules_info) # Réponse API frappe.response["message"] = [total_items, pricing_rules_info]

# -------------------------------------------

# Branche à exclure (services)
EXCLUDED_PARENT = "Services & Interventions"

# Groupes racine à ne jamais générer
EXCLUDED_ROOTS = {"All Item Groups", "Tous les Groupes d'Articles"}

# -------------------------------------------
# 1) SUPPRIMER LES ANCIENNES LISTES AUTO
# -------------------------------------------

old_docs = frappe.get_all(
    "Liste prix documents",
    filters={"génrer_automatique": 1},
    pluck="name",
)

for name in old_docs:
    try:
        doc = frappe.get_doc("Liste prix documents", name)
        if doc.docstatus == 1:
            doc.cancel()
        doc.delete(ignore_permissions=True)
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(message=str(e), title="Suppression Liste prix documents auto")

# -------------------------------------------
# 2) RÉCUPÉRER LES PRICE LISTS (VENTE)
# -------------------------------------------

price_lists = frappe.get_all(
    "Price List",
    filters={"selling": 1, "enabled": 1},
    pluck="name",
    order_by="name asc",
)

if not price_lists:
    frappe.throw("Aucune liste de prix de VENTE (selling=1, enabled=1) trouvée.")

# -------------------------------------------
# 3) RÉCUP ITEM GROUPS & EXCLUSIONS
# -------------------------------------------

all_groups = frappe.get_all(
    "Item Group",
    fields=["name", "parent_item_group", "is_group"]
)

by_name = {g["name"]: g for g in all_groups}

def is_under_excluded(group_name: str) -> bool:
    """True si le groupe est 'Services & Interventions' ou un de ses descendants."""
    current = group_name
    visited = set()
    while current and current not in visited:
        visited.add(current)
        if current == EXCLUDED_PARENT:
            return True
        parent = by_name.get(current, {}).get("parent_item_group")
        if not parent or parent == current:
            break
        current = parent
    return False

allowed_group_names = [
    g["name"]
    for g in all_groups
    if not is_under_excluded(g["name"])
    and g["name"] not in EXCLUDED_ROOTS
]

allowed_group_set = set(allowed_group_names)

# -------------------------------------------
# 4) CONSTRUIRE L'ORDRE GLOBAL DES GROUPES
# -------------------------------------------

visited = set()
catalog_order = []

def walk_group(name: str):
    if name in visited:
        return
    visited.add(name)

    if name in allowed_group_set:
        catalog_order.append(name)

    for child in order.get(name, []):
        walk_group(child)

for root_name in order.keys():
    walk_group(root_name)

remaining = sorted(
    [g for g in allowed_group_names if g not in visited]
)

sorted_groups = catalog_order + remaining

# -------------------------------------------
# 5) RÉFÉRENT EMPLOYÉ
# -------------------------------------------

referent_employee = frappe.db.get_single_value("AquaWorld Settings", "employee")
if not referent_employee:
    referent_employee = "HR-EMP-00003"

base_url = frappe.utils.get_url()

created = 0
skipped_empty = 0
failures = []

# -------------------------------------------
# 6) BOUCLE PRINCIPALE : PRICE LIST x GROUP
# -------------------------------------------

for price_list in price_lists:
    for group in sorted_groups:

        group_param = json.dumps([group])

        try:
            resp = frappe.make_get_request(
                base_url + "/api/method/gener_list_prix",
                params={
                    "list_group_item": group_param,
                    "list_prix": price_list,
                },
            )

            items = []
            promo_json = None

            if isinstance(resp, dict):
                data = resp.get("message")
                if isinstance(data, list):
                    if len(data) >= 1:
                        items = data[0] or []
                    if len(data) >= 2:
                        promo_json = data[1]
                elif isinstance(data, dict):
                    items = data.get("items") or []
                    promo_json = data.get("pricing_rules")
            elif isinstance(resp, list):
                items = resp

            if not items:
                skipped_empty += 1
                # continue

            # -----------------------------
            # Création du document
            # -----------------------------
            doc = frappe.new_doc("Liste prix documents")
            # Laisse ERPNext créer le nom avec naming_series
            doc.liste_des_prix = price_list
            doc.génrer_automatique = 1
            doc.référant = referent_employee

            if promo_json is not None:
                try:
                    doc.promo_json = json.dumps(promo_json)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            doc.append("group_articles", {"goup_articles": group})

            for it in items:
                if not isinstance(it, dict):
                    continue
                doc.append("liste_articles", {
                    "articles":       it.get("item_code"),
                    "group_articles": it.get("item_group"),
                    "nom_article":    it.get("item_name"),
                    "unité":          it.get("stock_uom"),
                    "description":    it.get("description"),
                    "marque":         it.get("brand"),
                    "tva":            it.get("tax_rate"),
                    "prix_ht":        it.get("price_ht"),
                    "prix_ttc":       it.get("price"),
                    "rem":       it.get("remise"),
                    "prix_ttc_promo": it.get("prix_ttc_promo"),
                })

            doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            doc.submit()

            # -----------------------------
            # Renommer le doc après submit
            # -----------------------------
            new_name = f"Liste Prix - {group} - {price_list}"
            if doc.name != new_name:
                try:
                    frappe.rename_doc(
                        "Liste prix documents",
                        doc.name,
                        new_name,
                        force=True,
                        ignore_permissions=True,
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    failures.append(f"{price_list} / {group} (rename)")
                    frappe.log_error(message=str(e), title="Rename Liste prix documents")

            created += 1

        except Exception as e:
            failures.append(f"{price_list} / {group}")
            frappe.log_error(message=str(e), title="Erreur génération Liste prix documents")

# -------------------------------------------
# 7) COMMIT & RÉSUMÉ
# -------------------------------------------

frappe.db.commit()

print(
    "Terminé. Créés: " + str(created) +
    " | Groupes vides ignorés: " + str(skipped_empty) +
    ((" | Échecs: " + ", ".join(failures)) if failures else "")
)
